personas.name: Policy lead
personas.role: Policy or strategy colleague in a department
personas.goal: Find out who in government already works on my policy area, before commissioning anything.
needs: Browse by topic and life event
pains: Code projects mean nothing to me
I can't tell what's live from what's abandoned
personas.entry: Home, then Explore repos or a topic

personas.name: Data leader

pains: Evidence of data practice is scattered

personas.name: Engineering and security lead

stories.want: find legacy technology and data in my estate
accept: Signals with evidence, filterable by organisation and sector

stories.want: see the tools and suppliers behind data work
accept: The table follows the chosen knowledge area

stories.so: I find anything without knowing where it lives

journeys.title: From a policy question to the right team

steps.action: Opens the catalogue from a link
Picks 'What are you interested in?' or searches in everyday words
Filters to 'being worked on' and their sector
Opens a profile at Simple reading level
Follows 'who it belongs to' and raises an issue with the catalogue's maintainers

journeys.pain: Most repositories have no description; summaries are written automatically and marked.

journeys.title: From estate question to remediation plan

steps.action: Opens Insights and analytics
Selects their knowledge areas on the DAMA wheel
Opens Legacy and technical debt for their organisation
Looks at peers in the family tree and organisation profiles
Downloads the CSV for a remediation plan

journeys.pain: Commercial tools used through their own interfaces leave little trace in public code.

journeys.title: Reuse before build

steps.action: Searches everything for the capability
Looks for an API and its catalogue entry
Reads licence, care checklist and activity
Finds related playbooks and standards
Records reuse, or contacts the owner

journeys.pain: 'Can I reuse it?' is often 'Not known' because licences aren't detected.

journeys.title: Move a co-cddo repository safely

steps.action: Reads the migration in six sentences
Finds their repository and its proposed home
Reviews dependencies and what breaks
Records a decision
Follows GitHub's documented behaviour

journeys.pain: Pages and links don't redirect; OIDC subjects change.

journeys.title: Join the catalogue to govukOS

steps.action: Reads what each app holds and the shared key
Uses the organisation crosswalk
Follows lineage from source to check
Downloads feeds and vocabularies
Uses the link scheme from other apps

journeys.pain: The other apps don't yet accept an organisation in their links.

journeys.title: Raise the standard of public code

steps.action: Opens Good practice across disciplines
Filters by type and sector
Finds retired libraries
Checks against the GDS Way
Re-checks after the next scan

journeys.pain: A file shows a practice is set up, not how well it's followed.

User actions: Raises an issue or contacts the publisher
Front stage (the page): Links to GitHub, GOV.UK, the repository's issues
Back stage (in the page): Search index built in the browser
Support processes: git checks, README and file reads

blueprints.title: Publishing a new release of the catalogue

Checks: File hash matches the tested file

blueprints.title: Joining govukOS apps on one organisation key

Back stage: GTI and ANA tables copied verbatim

workflows.title: Refresh the data
steps: Clone changed repositories (blobless) and read READMEs, file trees and manifests
Run classifiers: DAMA, APIs, open data, GDS, practices, legacy, themes
Read GOV.UK organisations; rebuild hierarchy and crosswalk
Sample and judge precision; fix rules with negative tests
workflows.yes: Fix the rule, add a negative test, rerun

workflows.title: Build and verify
steps: Embed data, fonts and test results
Run accessibility, width and contrast tests
workflows.no: Find the root cause, fix, record the defect and its check

workflows.title: Handle a reported defect
steps: Write a check that fails on the old build
Prove the check passes on the new build
Record it in the defect register and release notes

workflows.title: Answer a user question with the catalogue
workflows.no: Talk to the owner or build

workflows.title: Add a new classification
steps: Write the rule with word boundaries
workflows.yes: Ship, labelled 'judged by Claude, not owner-confirmed'

workflows.title: Integrate another govukOS app
steps: Read its ids and link scheme
Add its ids to the crosswalk
Add links out in its format
Offer feeds keyed by GOV.UK slug
Write the change for its owner
workflows.yes: Make the change with a check
workflows.no: Hand over the pack and instructions
